name: Unyielding Wristside
description: Bow with both blades lowered at the sides in the formal greeting that is also a ready guard.

name: Steelscute
description: Send both points along two thin parallel threads into the openings of the opponent's guard.

name: Vigor Fliptang
description: Advance one even pace with the blades mirroring each other across the line of the body.

name: Steel Doublehilt
description: Rise from the bow into a pair of qi-edged cuts that cross at the opponent's chest.

name: Entropy Swingguard
description: Let the loose sleeve of the left arm flick across the sight line while the right blade strikes.

name: Parity Platepoint
description: Sit low in the stance and turn each blow along the paired blades without leaving the seat.

name: Flurrydecree
description: Answer an opening move with two matched qi-weighted cuts that settle the first exchange.

name: Wingvow
description: Hold the blades in a formal ward that returns part of every blow along the foe's own steel.

name: Crossing Crown
description: Bring both edges down in one formal stroke backed by the field that closes the exchange.

name: Vaunted Shearedge
description: A school move that gathers the whole stance into one paired edge sized to the user's qi reserve.

name: Wingseal
description: Hold the first guard with blades curved inward like the sides of a shallow basin.

name: Quenched Scissor
description: Skim the edge across the foe's wrist as water runs over the lip of a basin.

name: Twilit Shearing
description: Take short settling steps that keep both blades low and the weight sunk in the legs.

name: Pallscute
description: Raise the blades like water rising up a basin's side and carry a cut up and over the shoulder.

name: Mothcrown
description: Hold qi in the blade a moment longer then let it spill through the target in one cut.

name: Unbending Shortedge
description: Cup the opposing blade in the curve of both guards and hold it as a basin holds water.

name: Dunewing
description: Step to the low side and let the foe's rush drain past like water finding its level.

name: Bedrock Hiltfold
description: Fill the space between the blades with qi until it holds against sustained heavy blows.

name: Squall Clipper
description: Release the filled guard over its brim in two cuts that follow one another like a spill.

name: Flurryedict
description: Gather the guard's stored force and flood the floor around the swordsman in a single violent cut.

name: Storied Cheekhilt Edict
description: A school move that floods the floor around the user with qi and edge sized to the reserve.

name: Hiltfold Vow
description: Hold the blades low and still like a hawk on its perch watching the foe's shoulders.

name: Unrivaled Edgepair
description: Snatch at the foe's guard hand with the hooked guard and cut with the other blade.

name: Edgepair Grace
description: Bank the whole body to one side and pass a thrust with both blades held out like wings.

name: Entropy Flurry
description: Stare hard at one point as a hawk would and cut at a different one with qi-quick speed.

name: Venom Shortedge
description: Rake the hooks down the opposing blade and tear it from its line with a pulse of qi.

name: Squall Shearedge
description: Lift both blades like rising wings on a thermal and throw a downward blow wide.

name: Scuteseal
description: Close both hooked guards on the foe's weapon arm and clamp it in a qi-tightened seizure.

name: Doublehilt Banner
description: Gather qi overhead and drop both points onto the same place on the foe in one fast plunge.

name: Seasonwing
description: Flash down on the foe from outside sight and strike before the sound of the dive arrives.

name: Radiance Platepoint
description: A school move that gathers the stance high and stoops with both blades on one point sized to the reserve.

name: Unyielding Cheekhilt
description: Stand with the blades parted and low at the start of the course like a spring at a river's head.

name: Pulsar Swingguard
description: Thrust along a thin straight channel with the second blade running just behind the first.

name: Peal Fliptang
description: Parry in a lazy S-curve that bends a blow round the body like a river's meander.

name: Delugepleat
description: Move close to the foe's flank the way a river runs close to its bank.

name: Matchless Flurry
description: A second cut joins the first like a tributary and doubles its weight at the point of meeting.

name: Commanding Crossing
description: Draw the opposing blade down and under with a sharp turn of both wrists.

name: Steelwing
description: Hold the crossed blades steady in the middle of an attack as a ford holds firm against the current.

name: Squallpleat
description: Rush forward through the exchange in quick surging steps like water through rapids.

name: Bedrock Snapcut
description: Bring two lines of attack together on the same point with a qi-weighted double cut.

name: Statute Wristside
description: Spread the guard wide and thin like a floodplain so each blow loses its force across it.

name: Bloomwing
description: Divide a heavy blow into many weak streams across the blades then send them back as one cut.

name: Harmonious Clipper Triumph
description: A school move that runs the whole course in one continuous flow of cuts sized to the reserve.

name: Stately Swingguard
description: Stand with the blades wide and relaxed under a calm field like the sky before weather.

name: Haemal Flurry
description: Cut in a long shallow curve that follows the line of a drifting cloud across the foe.

name: Edgepair Heraldry
description: Glide forward on the field with the blades extended so each step lands inside their reach.

name: Delugescute
description: Draw the field along the blades to meet a blow before the steel does and push it wide.

name: Haemal Scissor
description: Cut along a line of field that reaches slightly beyond the tip of the blade.

name: Hospitable Cheekhilt
description: Open the field to the horizon of the fight and feel every moving body around you.

name: Doublehilt Troth
description: Wrap two soft banks of field about the opposing blade and settle them on it like cloud.

name: Inviolate Wristside
description: Raise the field in a broad dome over the swordsman that blunts strikes from every side.

name: Entropy Shearedge
description: Turn with the blades out and sweep a wide field cut through every foe close around.

name: Wingodyssey
description: Cross the gap in a flash of field and cut through the guard with both blades.

name: Heroic Tempestuous Hiltfold
description: A school move that opens the whole field in a sky of edges and guard sized to the reserve.

name: Ironclad Platepoint
description: Rest the blades together at the hip so the guard looks relaxed and the draw is instant.

name: Inferno Snapcut
description: Cut with the warmth of the Core already in the wrists so the edge goes deeper than steel.

name: Vigor Shortedge
description: Take an unhurried step under a calm Core as steady as a hawk on level air.

name: Deluge Fliptang
description: Run a thread of Core qi along the blade and turn the foe's strike with almost no effort.

name: Mothverdict
description: Let the second blade echo the first thrust a beat later through the hole it opened.

name: Sigil Shearing
description: Hold the foe's weapon in the crossed blades by the steady pressure of a formed Core.

name: Undaunted Doublehilt
description: Anchor the guard on the Core and dissolve a heavy strike into the stillness of the blades.

name: Scutedecree
description: Bring both edges to one point with the full force of the Core behind each blade.

name: Vacuum Clipper
description: A single cut under a clear field that passes the guard and armor and wounds the body inside.

name: Bedrock Scissor
description: A school move that unites both blades and the Core in one cut and guard sized to the reserve.

name: Vigor Crossing
description: Take the first wind step of the course with the blades low and the breath open.

name: Devout Shearedge
description: Draw both blades in a gust-quick motion that flicks aside a cut aimed at the body.

name: Vaunted Snapcut
description: Jab straight and thin like a needle of wind into the gap between plates.

name: Bedrock Shearing
description: Take a bearing on the foe's center and close the distance along it without veering.

name: Steelpleat
description: Cut with a light qi-led edge that carries the speed of a breeze across the plateau.

name: Steel Cheekhilt
description: Hold the guard on the sworn ground and refuse the step back that the blow demands.

name: Platepoint Pledge
description: Hook the foe's blade from the side and pull it off the line the way a crosswind pulls a banner.

name: Squall Shearing
description: Reply to the foe's stroke with two wind-quick cuts spoken with a single sworn breath.

name: Revelation Shortedge
description: Turn the guard into a surface that sheds blows like gusts parting around a standing stone.

name: Seasonmoth
description: Speak the oath and cross the distance in one flash with both blades striking together.

name: Resonant Tenet Swingguard
description: A school move that chains step cut and guard in one oath-bound rush sized to the reserve.

name: Adamant Wristside
description: Stand plain and square on open ground with the blades short and ready at the sides.

name: Haemalmoth
description: Cut across level ground in a steady stroke that leaves no cover for the opponent to use.

name: Bedrock Flurry
description: Step through tall dry grass with the blades low and no sound to give the foe a mark.

name: Squall Hiltfold
description: Turn the blow along the wind that runs at the edge of the plateau and let it slip past.

name: Storied Fliptang
description: Chop with both short blades at once on a single target with qi gathered in the wrists.

name: Commanding Scissor
description: Hold the foe at the exact distance the oath sets with both guards pressing outward.

name: Vigorscute
description: Turn on the heel at the edge of a drop and cut the foe who follows with both blades.

name: Prismpleat
description: Spread a low field across the ground around the feet so the stance cannot be broken.

name: Scutepledge
description: Take the charge of a heavy foe into the planted guard and send the weight back in one cut.

name: Dauntless Clipper
description: A school move that sets both short blades in one open-ground stroke sized to the reserve.

name: Imperial Crossing
description: Pledge the sworn words on the draw and finish the cut as the last word falls.

name: Stalwart Shortedge
description: Set both blades against a gale of blows and keep the elbows locked to the ribs.

name: Noble Snapcut
description: Thrust long and straight like a lance of wind that finds the foe's center.

name: Hiltfold Boon
description: Hop on the ball of the foot with a gust of qi and land inside the guard.

name: Parity Doublehilt
description: Parry in the direction of the wind so the foe's blade is carried off its aim.

name: Intrepid Shearedge
description: Tear across the foe's guard with both edges in a gale-fast cut.

name: Vigormoth
description: Breathe the sworn words slowly and steady the qi through both wrists before the cut.

name: Masterful Cheekhilt
description: Wind the crossed blades round the foe's weapon until the wind of the bind rips it free.

name: Season Edgepair
description: Rush forward in a gale of qi chaining cuts and thrusts to the oath's last word.

name: Vacuumwing
description: Wrap the blades in a turning gale that bleeds the force from strikes on the guard.

name: Interstice Flurry
description: Cross the distance in a gale flash and cut with both edges in a single voice.

name: Vaunted Thunderclap Snapcut
description: A school move that speaks the oath in one gale cut sized to the user's reserve.

name: Bedrock Edgepair
description: Plant the stance on one chosen bearing and let every answer come from that line.

name: Bedrock Clipper
description: Cut along the held bearing so the edge keeps its line through any push.

name: Delugeflurry
description: After being pushed return in one step to the chosen bearing with blades still in guard.

name: Deluge Platepoint
description: Bend with the blow like a stalk in wind and spring straight again with the blades.

name: Lordly Crossing
description: Thrust down the held bearing with qi gathered in the point so no guard turns it.

name: Gracious Fliptang
description: Feel through the blades which way the foe's weight will lean before the step is taken.

name: Ironclad Fliptang
description: Hold the bearing against sustained heavy blows with a woven ward of qi and steel.

name: Squallmoth
description: Meet the foe's push on the line and throw it back with a cut that unbalances them.

name: Quelling Swingguard
description: Take a storm of blows on the line without a foot moving and return their weight in one cut.

name: Sacrosanct Wristside
description: A school move that holds the fixed line and answers on it in one stroke sized to the reserve.

name: Steel Swingguard
description: Stand angled to the wind of the fight with the blades loose and the weight in the balls of the feet.

name: Doublehilt Triumph
description: Slash from the foe's unwatched side in a blow the xiantian field makes a little longer than it looks.

name: Windborne Shearing
description: Step forward with the field spread so the pace is quiet and the stance never wavers.

name: Shortedge Pledge
description: Spread the field crosswise over the blade and push a blow sidelong off its line.

name: Matchless Snapcut
description: Lengthen the cut with field beyond the steel and land it at a surprising reach.

name: Peal Platepoint
description: Spread the field to learn each foe's range and bearing before the first stroke.

name: Sigil Cheekhilt
description: Pinion the opposing blade from the side with both guards and hold it with field and steel.

name: Prism Wristside
description: Raise a broad ward of field across the front that holds against a press of attackers.

name: Magmaflurry
description: Wheel on the spot with the field out from both blades and sweep the foes nearest the swordsman.

name: Nightmare Shearedge
description: Slip through the foe's guard as a crosswind slips a fence and strike from behind it.

name: Fearless Steel Scissor
description: A school move that joins crosswind step and sworn cut in one stroke sized to the reserve.

name: Consecrated Edgepair
description: Rest the blades crossed at the hip as a sworn guard that can open in a heartbeat.

name: Triumphant Clipper
description: Cut with wind drawn up from the Core into the wrists so the edge hums.

name: Vigor Shearing
description: Step evenly and without haste under a steady Core as a wind crosses open ground.

name: Pallwing
description: Turn the blow with a breath of Core wind along the blade and an easy flick of the wrist.

name: Thunderclap Flurry
description: Thrust with one blade and let the sworn mate follow into the hole it opened.

name: Scissor Seal
description: Hold the opposing weapon in the crossed blades with the quiet strength of a formed Core.

name: Paritywing
description: Anchor the guard on the Core and let the gale of qi dissolve any heavy strike.

name: Steel Hiltfold
description: Bring both blades to one point of the target under the full weight of the Core.

name: Retribution Edgepair
description: A single wind-swift cut that passes the guard and armor and wounds the body beneath.

name: Vigorpleat
description: A school move that unites gale and Core in one cut and guard sized to the user's reserve.
